# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time he adopted Nell Harcourt; deceased four years later.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c31 P18](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0018), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusually framed man with long, iron-gray hair reaching his hunching shoulders and warm brown eyes. From the age of twenty, he continuously wore a thick, gentle brown beard. He rarely wore fine clothes or a white collar except on rare, formal occasions.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Extremely bashful, shy, and taciturn, Obed felt uncomfortable around strangers and preferred quiet companions who did all the talking. He possessed a patient, soft-hearted, and tender nature, particularly toward Nell, whom he loved and indulged deeply. Although slow-minded and uncommunicative, he possessed a quiet, resolute stubbornness once his mind was made up.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c14 P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## Traits

- Extremely bashful and timid  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>
- Taciturn and silent  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019)</sub>
- Quietly stubborn  <sub>[v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024)</sub>
- Patient and soft-hearted  <sub>[v1 c14 P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Predicting the weather based on wind directions  <sub>[v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep Nell Harcourt at Grey Shutters and provide her with proper care and schooling  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Obed resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister Thirza. Seeking to hire a young boy from an asylum to help with farm work in his old age, he traveled to Alder River only to find that an orphan girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent by mistake. Unable to break the news to her, he brought her home and quietly insisted on keeping her, quickly forming a warm, affectionate bond with her. Over the next four years, he took immense pride in Nell's academic success and achievements, encouraging her ambitions and defending her against harsh judgments. His health gradually declined due to worsening heart spells, and he was forbidden from performing heavy farm labor. Shortly after Nell won the Avery scholarship, Obed passed away peacefully, leaving behind a lasting legacy of love and gratitude in Nell's heart.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Son of a bashful father who built Grey Shutters far back from the main road to avoid people  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his old age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
- Supported the Conservative political party as part of his faith  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009)</sub>
- Purchased a calf from Mr. Bell that he later gave to Nell  <sub>[v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016)</sub>
- Owned a red and white spotted handkerchief  <sub>[v2 c20 P16](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0016)</sub>
